Original quarantine writes carry actual case ownership and are parsed as actual complete JSON frames; APP raw/encoded counts and bytes are separate. preRelease verifies supported identities, probes required routes/consoles, inspects current status errors/children/identity-prefix turnover, then re-verifies routes before every actual provider return. Equal-size replacement is rejected. All closed observer failures increment the persistent sticky failure ledger; capture/drop/overflow failure counts block actual return.

Actual peer ledger is preregistered before cast/auth/lookup. Original body failure, fallback header IOException or unchecked failure, original close/wipe/accounting/removal failures are retained transiently and captured. Unexpected exiting errors become fresh fixed enum/count AssertionError with null cause/no originals suppressed; real peer thread joins still prove completion beyond counter zero.

Bounded terminalScan versions the actual capture tail and requires a stable complete final pass. Class finally captures status/late restore failures and terminal-scans before any wipe. Disposal requires genuine closure, successful restoration, completed final scans and no observation failure. Unsafe cases keep ledger and retain/reinstall the same supported quarantine via its already approved public stream setter; retained late errors get independent rescanning.
